introduction.text: Forte Tiburtina is one of Rome's 15 forts built between 1877 and 1891, located in the Collatino quarter of Municipio Roma IV. It played a key role in the city's defensive network and remains a notable example of late 19th‑century military architecture.

history.description: Construction of Forte Tiburtina from 1880 to 1884.

design.description: Forte Tiburtina is situated at the fourth kilometre of Via Tiburtina in the Collatino quarter, covering an area of 23.8 hectares.
